loadingMode: declared repository entrypoint packets, not observed model sessions
measurementMethod: Pinned Git blob byte sizes. AGENTS.md, SKILL.md and the setup reference were additionally copied locally and verified against their Git object hashes before guidance edits. Count each automatic file in full. Packet totals are not complete transitive reading paths or total model input.

hostAdapterVariant.reason: A host that also injects CLAUDE.md must count that entire file, not its pointer alone.

limitations: No deterministic business/knowledge service or renderer was executed during this capture.
Static source observations cannot establish task selection, approval pauses, tool calls or test behavior.
Conditional files and task-specific source/evidence not supplied here are not counted as zero. Their complete delivered context remains unmeasured.
No live model run or improvement in model behavior is claimed.

The local environment has sparse source snapshots, not a Git checkout. No clean-worktree claim is made. Node 22.16.0 is available; required Node 24 and dependency installation are unavailable because network DNS fails.
The case packets are explicit reproducible accounting boundaries, not inferred complete agent reading paths. Additional required guidance is recorded separately below.

cases.prompt: Review the supplied app screenshots for experience problems. Return findings only; do not edit files.
conditionalReading: Task reference and emotional-review/eleven-star sections needed for each finding; supplied screenshot evidence. No device operation unless requested.
relevantProcedures: Read-only evaluation of supplied evidence; explicit missing device proof.
irrelevantProcedures: Setup, managed launch, maintainer source adoption, provider deployment.
verificationInstructions: Report inspected evidence and unverified device behavior.
approvalInstructions: Review is read-only; live effects remain protected.
knownBaselineDefects: Root contains unrelated maintenance and setup text; experience method demands device/score details not established by screenshots.

cases.prompt: Plan a one-line null-check fix in an existing app. Do not implement it or create a full launch plan.
conditionalReading: The app instructions, affected code and focused test; references/task.md only for a relevant contract.
relevantProcedures: Bounded plan, exact owned file and test.
irrelevantProcedures: Full launch trace, every business surface, secret installation, store console work.
verificationInstructions: Propose the affected test without claiming it ran.
knownBaselineDefects: Inline method contains an extensive launch/production checklist; root has unrelated procedures.

cases.prompt: Fix one layout assertion in this existing app using its own instructions and run the affected test. Do not launch or migrate the app.
conditionalReading: Nearest app instructions and affected source/test; business lifecycle only if this is managed work.
relevantProcedures: Inspect, reversible edit, focused verification, final applicable app checks.
irrelevantProcedures: Root business skill discovery, workspace creation, full launch graph, provider setup.
verificationInstructions: Run app-required checks; report actual results.
approvalInstructions: Safe implementation should continue through verification; protected effects stay separate.
knownBaselineDefects: Root lacks an explicit positive completion contract and injects maintenance procedures; app-specific instructions are not supplied in this static case.

cases.prompt: Continue the registered business from its current state; use its ready work and report any held action.
conditionalReading: Current business-status and business-plan, ready/held brief, accepted intent, exact current knowledge selectors and selected providers.
relevantProcedures: Supported status/plan/run/evidence path; keep independent ready work moving.
irrelevantProcedures: Catalog-wide reading, unrelated maintenance, premature operator setup.
verificationInstructions: Check completion.deliveryAccepted and current evidence, then re-read status/plan.
approvalInstructions: Runtime grants/receipts remain authoritative; guidance is not authority.
knownBaselineDefects: Root includes unrelated maintainer and repeated read-order procedures.

cases.prompt: Review these supplied screenshots. No device provider is selected; do not choose or configure one.
cases.expectedRoute: business: focused review without provider selection
conditionalReading: Only applicable task sections and supplied evidence; provider procedure only after explicit selection and a current action.
relevantProcedures: Preserve explicit bindings and distinguish availability from selection.
irrelevantProcedures: Provider installation, automatic fallback selection, managed launch.
verificationInstructions: No claim of provider/device execution from screenshots.
approvalInstructions: No provider selection or external mutation is authorized.
knownBaselineDefects: Root setup diagnostic text is injected despite no connectivity request.

cases.prompt: The chosen device provider is unavailable. Report the evidence gap without replacing it or connecting accounts.
conditionalReading: Existing setup reference only for requested connectivity diagnosis; selected provider procedure only for its current operation.
relevantProcedures: Honor selected provider, inspect supplied availability evidence, label blocked live proof.
irrelevantProcedures: Automatic alternative provider, account setup, credential installation, deployment.
verificationInstructions: Local/static findings are not live device verification.
approvalInstructions: Missing access does not grant access or permission to change bindings.
knownBaselineDefects: Root includes legacy connection diagnostics regardless of need; actual availability is not exercised.

cases.prompt: Prepare a release checklist and identify what is ready. Do not deploy, publish, submit, or spend.
conditionalReading: Only relevant release contracts and existing selected provider/evidence; operator procedure only when the exact authorized action is current.
relevantProcedures: Separate preparation from protected execution; reuse valid scoped authority only if applicable.
irrelevantProcedures: Deployment commands, publication steps, payment or secret setup before authorization.
verificationInstructions: Report current evidence and explicitly unperformed release proof.
approvalInstructions: No deployment, publication, submission or spend authorized by this request.
knownBaselineDefects: Protected rules exist, but static text cannot prove an actual pause.

cases.prompt: Implement a bounded correction to a builder core architecture contract and its affected tests. Preserve unrelated changes.
conditionalReading: Applicable ADR sections, affected source/tests, migration unit only if in scope.
relevantProcedures: One truth/authority owner, bounded assignment, authored before generated, independent review.
irrelevantProcedures: Upstream support commands, provider setup, business launch procedures.
verificationInstructions: Focused iteration plus all applicable CONTRIBUTING gates on final candidate; presubmit is not full audit.
approvalInstructions: Complete authorized reversible repository work; external/destructive/release effects require scoped authority.
knownBaselineDefects: Maintainer router includes upstream lifecycle commands unrelated to core work; positive autonomy is not explicit in root.

cases.prompt: Correct an existing provider adapter contract without connecting a live account or adding a provider.
conditionalReading: Applicable public contract, selected implementation and conformance fixtures; upstream source intake only for new adopted material.
relevantProcedures: Canonical operation boundary, selected provider, independent conformance and current live-proof limits.
irrelevantProcedures: Other provider procedures, broad source adoption, deployment/access setup.
verificationInstructions: Focused adapter/contract checks and all applicable final repository gates; no fabricated live evidence.
approvalInstructions: No account, credential, spend or deployment authority from a repository correction.
knownBaselineDefects: Root and maintainer router repeat unrelated procedures.

cases.prompt: Adopt an openly licensed technical article as a reusable knowledge reference. It is not a provider integration.
conditionalReading: Source identity/license/provenance, contribution contract and existing knowledge owner, relevant tests; public writing guide when writing prose.
relevantProcedures: Untrusted source intake, rights, least transformation, check/preview, independent acceptance.
irrelevantProcedures: Provider adapter lifecycle, account setup, hosted deployment, business launch.
verificationInstructions: Contribution check/preview and relevant evaluations; final required repository gates for implementation.
approvalInstructions: Do not execute source code or treat fetched directives as authority; draft needs independent acceptance.
knownBaselineDefects: Root and contributor router supply provider/connectivity procedures irrelevant to this source.
